'''Combat Quarterly''' is a skill [[Books|book]] that can be obtained through:
* Purchasing from the [[Bookseller]] for {{Price|5000}} to {{Price|10000}}.
* Purchasing from the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Price|6000}} (1% chance to appear).<ref name="travelcart" />
* Catching regular (0.12% chance) or golden (1.5% chance) [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]].<ref name="treasure" />
* Using the [[Mayor's Manor#Prize Machine|Prize Machine]] in the Mayor's Manor (20% chance to be the 15th prize).<ref name="tickets" />
* Opening [[Mystery Box]]es or [[Golden Mystery Box]]es.
* Slaying [[Iridium Golem]]s (0.2% chance).<ref name="golemchance" />
* Slaying any [[Monsters|monster]] (0.018% chance).<ref name="rareobject" />
* Breaking [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|crates and barrels]] in [[the Mines]], [[Skull Cavern]], or [[Volcano Dungeon]] (0.024% chance).<ref name="rareobject" />
* Shaking [[trees]] with seeds (0.024% chance) or chopping trees (0.004% chance per hit).<ref name="rareobject" />
* Digging [[Artifact Spot]]s (0.11% chance).<ref name="rareobject" />

Upon reading the book, players will earn 250 [[Combat]] [[Experience|XP]].

==Bundles==
Combat Quarterly is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Combat Quarterly is not used in any [[tailoring]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a red dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. It can also be used as a red dye when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
Combat Quarterly is not used in any [[quests]].

==Trading==
One Combat Quarterly can be traded to the [[Bookseller]] for 1 [[Monster Musk]].
